title: Commutators of a class of $Ψ$-bounded oscillation operators on abstract weighted Orlicz-Morrey spaces endowed with ball-basis and applications
summary: In our previous work \cite{SZ2026}, we established a class of abstract Orlicz-Morrey spaces endowed with a ball-basis and introduced the notion of \(Ψ\)-bounded oscillation operators. The present paper further develops this theory by investigating sparse domination and weighted estimates for such operators and their commutators within the framework of abstract Orlicz-Morrey spaces endowed with a ball-basis.
